actions.action: Decide how FLOOR.md clause iii and floor_core_changed should agree, then add the clause-derived tests for floor_anchor.py

actions.done_when: Each FLOOR.md clause maps to a test written from its text, and a scripts/contract/ change requests floor-signoff (or clause iii no longer lists it)
actions.scope_fence: Floor files: changes need the maintainer's out-of-band floor-signoff approval; no agent edits

actions.action: Add the clause-integrity and token-floor tests for floor_check.py from the #410 review, independent of REQUIRED_CLAUSES and MINIMUM_TOKEN_COUNT

actions.action: Annotate test_keyhole_signals.py as a tracked large file and split it by finding family only when a change needs most of it
